title: Financial Analyst
must_haves: Degree in finance, accounting or economics; Excel financial modelling or budgeting; 2+ years in financial analysis, FP&A or reporting
nice_to_haves: Professional qualification in progress (CFA, ACCA); SQL or Python; variance analysis
description: Support monthly reporting, build forecasts and budgets, analyse variances against plan, and prepare decks for management.

title: Audit / Accounting Associate
must_haves: Degree in accounting; hands-on general ledger, reconciliations or month-end close; 1+ years in accounting or audit
nice_to_haves: CPA or ACCA (completed or in progress); audit firm experience; accounting software such as SAP, QuickBooks or Oracle
description: Prepare journal entries and reconciliations, support month-end close, and assist with internal and external audits.

title: Credit / Loan Officer
must_haves: Assessing loan or credit applications; analysing borrower income, financial statements or credit reports; 2+ years in banking or lending
nice_to_haves: Mortgage or consumer lending; loan origination software; degree in finance or business
description: Review loan applications, assess borrower affordability and credit risk, recommend approvals, and keep files compliant with lending policy.

title: Business Analyst (Consulting)
must_haves: Degree in business, finance, economics or IT; gathering requirements or documenting business processes; data analysis using Excel, SQL or a BI tool
nice_to_haves: Client-facing consulting projects; process mapping; project management certification
description: Work with client teams to map current processes, analyse data, identify improvements, and write recommendations.

title: Business Development Executive
must_haves: Generating leads or prospecting new clients or partners; managing a pipeline in a CRM; 2+ years in business development, partnerships or account management
nice_to_haves: Negotiating contracts or partnership terms; stated revenue or deal targets; startup or tech sector
description: Find and qualify new partners and clients, run outreach, manage the pipeline, and hand closed deals to account teams.

title: B2B Sales Executive
must_haves: 2+ years in a sales role; selling to businesses rather than consumers; results against a sales target or quota stated in the CV
nice_to_haves: CRM use; key account management; cold calling or outbound prospecting
description: Own a territory of business customers, run the sales cycle from first call to close, and hit monthly and quarterly targets.

title: HR / Talent Acquisition Executive
must_haves: Recruitment work such as sourcing, screening or interviewing candidates; 2+ years in HR; HR administration such as onboarding, payroll or employee records
nice_to_haves: Applicant tracking system or HRIS; HR certification (e.g. SHRM, PHR); knowledge of employment law
description: Manage end-to-end hiring for several teams, coordinate interviews and offers, and run onboarding for new joiners.

title: IT Systems Analyst
must_haves: Degree in IT, computer science or a related field; supporting, configuring or maintaining business systems or networks; 2+ years in technical support or systems work
nice_to_haves: SQL; cloud platforms; ITIL; scripting (Python, PowerShell)
description: Maintain and improve internal business systems, troubleshoot issues, document configurations, and work with users on requirements.

title: Digital Marketing Executive
must_haves: Running digital campaigns (social media, SEO, email or paid ads); reporting campaign results with an analytics tool; creating digital content
nice_to_haves: Google Ads or Meta Ads certification; design tools such as Photoshop or Canva; degree in marketing
description: Plan and run online campaigns, produce content for social and email, track performance, and report results to the team.

title: PR / Communications Executive
must_haves: Writing press releases or media materials; managing media relations or press contacts; degree in communications, journalism, PR or marketing
nice_to_haves: Crisis communications; event management; managing corporate social media accounts
description: Write and pitch press releases, manage journalist relationships, coordinate events, and protect the company's public image.
